name: Level-Bounded Minimum Maximum-Parent Rank
definition: For a class $C$ and $k\ge0$, $h_k(C)$ is the least rank of a maximum parent of $C$ belonging to $\mathcal D_k$, with value infinity if no such parent exists. Write $h_D(C)$ for the least rank over dismantlable maximum parents.
parameters: Nonnegative decomposition-level bound $k$; the comparison value $h_D$ removes the fixed-level bound.
normalization: Parent rank is its VC dimension; auxiliary coordinates and the marked section are otherwise unrestricted.
